bug_report.title: CRITICAL: --controller-mode balance-core Does Not Disable WBC
bug_report.impact: All balance-core mode runs are actually running with WBC active

evidence.expected: tau_wbc_scaled_per_joint should be 0.0 at ALL steps in balance-core mode
evidence.actual: WBC is active and contributing torque throughout the run

root_cause.problem: include_wbc is determined by legacy stage2b_ablation_mode, NOT by controller_mode argument
root_cause.missing_check: No check for args.controller_mode == 'balance-core' to force include_wbc = False

required_fix.action: Add check for args.controller_mode == 'balance-core' to force include_wbc = False
required_fix.code_addition:
if args.controller_mode == 'balance-core':
    include_wbc = False
    include_hip_roll = False
    include_wheel_balance = False

immediate_action: Re-run all balance-core validations with fixed script
Verify WBC is actually disabled via telemetry
Only then proceed with Step E validation
do_not: Proceed with Step E validation using current buggy script
Claim balance-core mode works based on current telemetry
Tune controller gains based on WBC-contaminated runs
Proceed to Step C until true balance-core mode is validated

phase_1_status.finding: Legacy-mode visual run was in wrong mode
phase_1_status.validity: STILL VALID - that run was explicitly in legacy/upright mode
phase_1_status.note: However, subsequent 'balance-core' runs are also compromised by this WBC bug
